CREATE PROC [DW].[HIST_SP_DW_FACTLOANSOUTSTANDINGBALANCE] AS
BEGIN



WITH CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)
,Cnt_DimCustomerAccount
AS(
select Accountid,
count(shareindicator) as CNT
 from dw.dimcustomeraccount where shareindicator = 'y'
 group by accountid
)
,Balance AS (
SELECT 
 BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,BRPP.AccountId
,SUM(AmortizationAmount) AS AmortizationAmount
,SUM(InterestAmount) AS InterestAmount
,SUM(PenaltyAmount) AS PenaltyAmount
,SUM(AmortizationAmount) + SUM(InterestAmount) + SUM(PenaltyAmount) AS OutstandingBalanceFull
,(SUM(AmortizationAmount) + SUM(InterestAmount) + SUM(PenaltyAmount) ) / DCA.CNT  AS OutstandingBalanceProrated
,'LNS' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
FROM (
         SELECT
         CONVERT(VARCHAR,BRPP.DemandEffectiveDate,112) AS BusinessDateSK
        ,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
        ,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
        ,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
        ,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
        ,CASE WHEN BRPP.DemandFlowId = 'PRDEM' THEN 
              CASE WHEN BRPP.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BRPP.DemandAmount * CC.ConversionRate ELSE BRPP.DemandAmount END
         ELSE 0 END AS AmortizationAmount
        ,CASE WHEN BRPP.DemandFlowId = 'INDEM' THEN 
              CASE WHEN BRPP.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BRPP.DemandAmount * CC.ConversionRate ELSE BRPP.DemandAmount END  
         ELSE 0 END AS InterestAmount
        ,CASE WHEN BRPP.DemandFlowId = 'APDEM' THEN 
              CASE WHEN BRPP.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BRPP.DemandAmount * CC.ConversionRate ELSE BRPP.DemandAmount END
         ELSE 0 END AS PenaltyAmount
        FROM 
        [BNKM].[RepaymentPlanPayment] BRPP
        LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BRPP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
        LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
        LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON BRPP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
        LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA ON BRPP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
        LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON BRPP.IsoCurrencyCode = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BRPP.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BRPP.DemandDate = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
) BRPP
LEFT JOIN Cnt_DimCustomerAccount DCA ON DCA.AccountId = BRPP.AccountId

GROUP BY 
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,BRPP.AccountId
,DCA.CNT
)
,GetMinMaxDate AS (
SELECT 
	BranchSK,
	BankSK,
	AccountSK,
    AccountId,
	SourceSystemCode, 
    MIN(BusinessDateSK) as min_date, 
    CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()) max_date 
  FROM 
    Balance
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
    GROUP BY BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountID ,SourceSystemCode
)
,FullDateBalance AS (
SELECT 
	b.BranchSK,
    b.BankSK,
    b.AccountSK,
    b.AccountID,
	b.SourceSystemCode,
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,FullDate,112) AS FullDate2,
    a.FullDate, 
    b.min_date, 
    b.max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.dimdate a 
    LEFT JOIN GetMinMaxDate b
	ON a.FullDate >= b.min_date 
    AND a.FullDate <= b.max_date 
  WHERE 
    (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
,Distinct_Balance AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    BranchSK, BankSK, AccountSK, AccountId, BusinessDateSK, AmortizationAmount, 
	InterestAmount, PenaltyAmount, OutstandingBalanceFull, OutstandingBalanceProrated, SourceSystemCode, WorkFlowId, TaskRunId, InsertDttm
FROM Balance b
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
INSERT INTO  DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance
(
     BusinessDateSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AmortizationAmount
    ,InterestAmount
    ,PenaltyAmount
    ,OutstandingBalanceFull
    ,OutstandingBalanceProrated
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
ISNULL(b.BusinessDateSK, a.FullDate) AS BusinessDateSK
,ISNULL(b.BranchSK,a.BranchSK) AS BranchSK
,ISNULL(b.BankSK,a.BankSK) AS BankSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountSK,a.AccountSK) AS AccountSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountId,a.AccountId) AS AccountId

,MAX(AmortizationAmount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode
ORDER BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode) AS AmortizationAmount

,MAX(InterestAmount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode
ORDER BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode) AS InterestAmount

,MAX(PenaltyAmount) OVER (PARTITION BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode
ORDER BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode) AS PenaltyAmount

,MAX(OutstandingBalanceFull) OVER (PARTITION BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode
ORDER BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode) AS OutstandingBalanceFull

,MAX(OutstandingBalanceProrated) OVER (PARTITION BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode
ORDER BY a.BranchSK ,a.BankSK ,a.AccountSK ,a.AccountId ,a.SourceSystemCode) AS OutstandingBalanceProrated

,ISNULL(b.SourceSystemCode,a.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm
FROM FullDateBalance a
LEFT JOIN Distinct_Balance b
    ON a.BranchSK = b.BranchSK
    AND a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    AND a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    AND a.AccountID = b.AccountID
    AND a.fulldate2 = b.BusinessDateSK
    AND a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode

END
GO
